question: Canard passed the halfway marker at 1:07:50. What was his average speed for the second half of the race?
explanation: Canard's total time = 2:13:31 = 8011s. Halfway time = 1:07:50 = 4070s. Second half time = 8011 − 4070 = 3941s. Distance = 21.1 km. Speed = 21.1 ÷ (3941 ÷ 3600) ≈ 19.27 km/h.

question: Dennis and Ekimov passed the "1km to go" marker at exactly the same time, 2:11:00. How much faster than Ekimov did Dennis run in the last kilometre?
explanation: Both reached the 1km marker at 2:11:00 = 7860s. Dennis finished at 2:14:12 = 8052s → last km in 192s. Ekimov at 2:14:20 = 8060s → last km in 200s. Speed ∝ 1/time: (200 − 192) ÷ 192 × 100 ≈ 4.2% faster.

question: Benoit ran the last 150m at a speed 5% faster than his overall average for the race. How far was Benoit from the finishing line when Anderson finished?
explanation: Benoit total = 7958s; Anderson = 7934s → 24s remaining for Benoit when Anderson finishes. Benoit avg speed = 42200 ÷ 7958 ≈ 5.303 m/s. Last 150m speed = 5.303 × 1.05 ≈ 5.568 m/s. Time for last 150m = 150 ÷ 5.568 ≈ 26.9s > 24s, so Benoit is in the last 150m. Distance left = 24 × 5.568 ≈ 133m.
